BY virtue of power vested in the Minister in charge of Local Government in the Central Province Provincial Council under subSection (1) of Section 268 of the Municipal Councils Ordinance, read together with Section 2 of the Provincial Councils(Consequential Provisions) Act, No. 12 of 1989, it is hereby notified that the draft By Laws approved by him and publishedin the Schedule in Part IV (A) Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka, has been resolved by the CentralProvince Provincial Council, under sub Section (1) of Section 268 of the Municipal Councils Ordinance, read together withSection 2 of the Provincial Council (Consequential Provisions) Act, No. 12 of 1989.
